name: 993 Turbo three-into-one exhaust manifold, IN625 (PicoGK)
picogk_enhancement: Bionic: the legacy three-into-one flow body (primaries, collector, flanges) is kept exactly and its passages, bolt holes and nut clearances are cut at exact size; webs and gussets between the primaries, the head flange and the outlet flange are grown by 3D SIMP topology optimization (bionic.json, topopt.py) under assumed loads: 400 N along and across the port row (turbo mass share 4 kg x 10 g) and 250 N axial (screen collector pressure force + inertia) on the outlet flange, head flange clamped. Thermal growth is not a SIMP load. Loads are assumptions until measured.

total_length_mm.note: TOTAL_LENGTH_MM in parts/993-eng-exhaust-manifold-in625-f0-0001/source/exhaust_manifold.py (axial envelope of the F0)

bend_control_z_mm.note: Bezier control height: primaries leave the ports vertically and bend toward the collector

head_flange_thickness_mm.note: common port flange thickness; flange absent from the F0 STEP

head_flange_rim_mm.note: flange rim around each primary OD

bolt_hole_diameter_mm.note: M8 clearance assumed; no stud pattern published

nut_clearance_radius_mm.note: spot-face / nut clearance above the bolt bosses

outlet_flange_thickness_mm.note: turbine-side flange thickness; turbine interface not measured

outlet_flange_radius_mm.note: outlet flange radius, kept inside the F0 66.4 mm depth

outlet_bolt_offset_mm.note: outlet bolt centres at x = +/-42 mm

fillet_mm.note: outer fillet radius of crotch and flange roots

open_interfaces: cylinder-head exhaust port positions, shape and stud pattern
heat exchanger (heating) shell, supports and installed routing
primary diameter, wall and merge length (all F0 hypotheses)
